id: \bJames: Jessie, how much longer do we have to be here?
en: \bJames: Jessie, how much longer do we have to be here?
it: \bJames: Jessie, quanto dobbiamo restare ancora qui?

id: \rJessie: Quiet. You noticed those other guys in here. They must be after some treasure.
en: \rJessie: Quiet. You noticed those other guys in here.  They must be after some treasure.
it: \rJessie: Silenzio. Hai notato quegli altri tizi qui dentro. Devono essere a caccia di qualche tesoro.

id: \bMeowth: Not the twerp. Hurry up and take care of them!
en: \bMeowth: Not the twerp. Hurry up and take care of them!
it: \bMeowth: Non il moccioso! Sbrigatevi a sistemarli!
